indicator_definition: Total GHG emissions per unit of GDP in kilograms of CO₂ equivalent per GDP unit (constant prices). Tracks decoupling of economic growth from emissions. Compiled by Eurostat.
rationale: Reducing GHG intensity is essential for sustainable production. Progress means a sustained decline in emissions per unit of GDP.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled from national GHG inventories and national accounts under ESA 2010. Published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Greenhouse gas emissions intensity of production
graph_title: Greenhouse gas emissions intensity of production
